summary: Full backend + frontend regression on Utrerapp v2 hyperflex features: 401 auth gating, new comercio/hosteleria fields (menu_pdf_url, oferta_*, instagram/facebook/tiktok, telefono, direccion, web, fotos[]), localStorage fallback in Admin, MERGE of API+local in Market/Bares/Vivienda, image sanitation (safeImg/cleanPhotos) and conditional rendering of PDF/promo/socials. All 7 pytest cases pass; all 25+ frontend assertions pass. Train/chat smoke OK.

issues: Radix Dialog warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent (a11y only, non-blocking)

action_items: (Optional / a11y) Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to ShopDetail/PlaceDetail Dialogs to silence Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1000+ lines — consider splitting into routers (admin, catalog, chat).
ADMIN_TOKENS stored in-memory set → tokens lost on backend restart (acceptable for MVP but worth noting; combined with new localStorage fallback the UX is covered).

Admin.jsx AdminSection renderRow for comercios/hosteleria still renders directly without isValidImage() — empty strings fall back to onError handler which is fine but isValidImage would avoid the request entirely.
seed_data_creation: No backend seeds added. Frontend tests inject local_comercios/local_hosteleria/local_inmuebles via page.evaluate(localStorage.setItem).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend v2 fields are stable. Fallback flow verified: deleting utrerapp_admin_token then submitting admin-form-comercios triggers 401, Admin catches error and stores in local_comercios with _local:true and generates loc-* id; item appears with 📴 indicator and can be deleted locally. Public Market tab 'moda' lists local items including those with empty imagen/fotos (no empty rendered). ShopDetail / PlaceDetail render market-menu-pdf, market-promo, market-socials strictly conditionally. Bares and Vivienda work identically. If adding more hyperflex fields, extend NEW_COMERCIO_FIELDS in test_utrerapp_v2.py.
